t: Din chametz shennimtza bachanut yisrael vehappoalim nokrim o behepek
s: Din chametz shennimtza bachanut yisrael vehappoalim nokrim o behepek ubo g' seipim: chanut umelay (perush: sechora, kegon pat veyayin hannimkar betokah) shebbetokah shel yisrael upoalim hammishtaddelim bah bimkirat hamlay hen nokrim — chametz hannimtza bachanut zo leachar happesach asur apillu bahanaa, shebbevadday hu min hamlay shel yisrael, veen tolin lehaqel lomar shemmin nokrim happoalim napal shamma, kevan shehamlay qabua bachanut tamid, vehappoalim enan qebuim tamid ella niknasin veyotzein:
Chanut umelay shel nokri vehappoalim hem yisrael — chametz hannimtza sham leachar happesach muttar apillu baakila, shebbevadday hu min hamlay shel nokri:

Vekol zeh kesheyyesh chametz bammelay hannimkar betok hachanut, sheepshar litlot shechametz zeh hannimtza hu min hamlay, abal im hu beinyan shei epshar litlot shechametz zeh hu min hamlay — hare hakkol holek achar happoalim, im hen yisrael ap al pi shehachanut umelay shel nokri — hare hechametz asur apillu bahanaa, shebbevadday min happoalim napal shamma. Veap al pi shekkesheyyatzeu happoalim min hachanut qodem happesach bevadday kebar nityaashu min hechametz shennapal mehem betok hachanut shel nokri shehannokri yimtzaehu veyoklehu, veim ken haya chametz zeh kol yeme happesach hepqer gamur velo aberu alayv happoalim be"bal yeraeh" u"bal yimmatze", mikkol maqom hare kebar nitbaer besiman tm"ch sheap chametz shel yisrael shehipqiro qodem happesach asur bahanaa leachar happesach. Veim happoalim hen nokrim, ap al pi shehachanut umelay shel yisrael — hare hechametz muttar apillu baakila. Veap al pi shekkesheyyatzeu happoalim min hachanut qodem happesach bevadday nityaashu min hechametz shennapal mehen venaasa hechametz hepqer gamur, vekol debar hepqer hammunnach birshuto shel adam miyyisrael zokta lo reshuto veniqneh lo hahepqer venaaseh keshello mammash, ap al pi ken lo niqneh lehayyisrael chametz zeh shehaya bachanuto kol yeme happesach, mittaam shennitbaer besiman tm"ch ayyen sham:
